footer.disclaimer: Praja is an independent civic platform. It is not affiliated with any government body or political party.
home.tagline: Your constituency. Your voice. On the record.
home.hero.subcopy: Raise a local issue, and PrajaSabha routes it to the authority actually responsible — with the routing and the outcome both on the public record.
home.stats.verifiedConstituents.label: verified constituents
home.features.neutral.title: Strictly neutral
home.features.neutral.body: No party affiliation, no editorializing — issues are routed by law, not by politics.
home.features.oneVoice.title: One citizen, one voice
home.features.oneVoice.body: Every verified constituent gets exactly one vote of support per issue — no bots, no duplicates.
home.features.record.title: Everything on the record
home.features.record.body: Every issue's routing and timeline is public and permanent — nothing is quietly edited or deleted.
home.howItWorks.title: How it works
home.howItWorks.step1.title: Verify once
home.howItWorks.step1.body: Register with your email, then verify your voter ID (EPIC) to unlock full participation.
home.howItWorks.step2.title: Raise & support issues
home.howItWorks.step2.body: Report a local problem, or add your support to one already raised in your ward.
home.howItWorks.step3.title: Track it
home.howItWorks.step3.body: Every issue gets a public timeline — see when it's published, routed, and acted on.
home.cta.register.body: Register with your email to raise and support local issues.
home.cta.verifyEpic.body: Verify your EPIC (voter ID) to raise issues, support them, and vote.
home.cta.raiseIssue.body: Tell us what's wrong in your ward — we'll route it to the right authority.
